claims.statement: The /api/tasks namespace is split into four logical groups anchored off /api/tasks (collection: GET, POST, bulk DELETE) and /api/tasks/:taskId (per-task: GET, PATCH, DELETE; lifecycle helpers messages, clear-logs, continue; execution-control helpers start-sandbox, stop-sandbox, sandbox-health, restart-dev; GitHub PR and deployment helpers pr, merge-pr, close-pr, reopen-pr, sync-pr, sync-changes, reset-changes, check-runs, pr-comments, deployment; live-editor helpers files, file-content, diff, save-file, terminal, lsp, autocomplete, file-operation, create-file, create-folder, delete-file, discard-file-changes, project-files).
